name: producer-declares-uninterpretable-version-warns
description: a declaration that is not a MAJOR.MINOR identifier cannot be compared, and is handled like a newer one: proceed, and warn
kill: treat an uninterpretable protocolVersion as equal to the client's own, so it passes without a warning — or reject the run over it

dotnet.intentional: .NET does not implement the version-declaration comparison, so an uninterpretable protocolVersion is carried without ever being read and the replay is silent. `warnings` is emptied only to displace the base expectation; `noWarnings` is what asserts the silence. Alignment tracked separately.
